papers.title: OAT：面向自回归机器人策略的有序动作分词
papers.summary: 把连续机器人动作交给自回归策略时，现有分词器要么序列过长，要么缺乏因果顺序。OAT通过嵌套dropout与寄存器机制，将动作块压缩为从粗到细、任意前缀均可解码的离散词元，在20余项仿真任务与真实操作上优于扩散和流匹配基线。它在推理时支持按需调节词元数以权衡精度与延迟，但离散重建误差和跨本体通用性仍待验证。
papers.summaryEn: When feeding continuous robot actions to autoregressive policies, existing tokenizers yield overly long sequences or lack causal ordering. OAT uses nested dropout and registers to compress action chunks into coarse-to-fine discrete tokens whose prefixes are all decodable, outperforming diffusion and flow-matching baselines across 20+ simulated and real manipulation tasks. It trades accuracy for latency via variable prefix decoding, though discretization error and cross-embodiment transfer remain open.
papers.whySelected: RSS 2026 正式主会录用论文；用有序离散词元打通自回归动作生成与按需解码，对 VLA 动作表征设计极具参考价值。

xun.relation: 直接连接连续动作分块、离散词元化（FAST/VQ-VAE）与自回归机器人策略。
prerequisites: 自回归序列建模 / Autoregressive modeling

lv.relation: 衔接视觉运动模仿学习与 VLA 离散动作头设计，适合与扩散策略对照阅读。
prerequisites: 模仿学习基础 / Imitation learning basics

limits: 离散分词本质上引入重建量化误差，超高精度接触任务下可能需更长前缀词元。 / Discrete tokenization introduces quantization error and may need longer prefixes for fine contact tasks.
当前主要在单臂桌面与仿真基准验证，尚未系统检验双臂高自由度灵巧手的跨本体词表复用。 / Primarily evaluated on single-arm tabletop and simulation benchmarks; cross-embodiment bimanual dexterous reuse is untested.
assumptions: 动作块存在可由低维到高维分层表达的时空相关性，且训练分布覆盖目标任务动作空间。 / Assumes action chunks exhibit coarse-to-fine spatiotemporal structure covered by training data.

papers.title: FPO++：面向机器人控制的流匹配策略梯度
papers.titleEn: Flow Policy Gradients for Robot Control
papers.summary: 传统策略梯度依赖高斯等显式似然分布，限制了多模态动作表达。FPO++改进流匹配策略梯度目标，无需精确计算动作似然即可直接从奖励训练和微调高表达力流策略，在足式行走、人形动作跟踪与操作任务中实现双平台零样本真机迁移。它为强化学习引入生成式动作分布提供了实用方案，但多步采样开销与超参敏感性仍需权衡。
papers.summaryEn: Likelihood-based policy gradients restrict policies to simple Gaussians, limiting multimodal action expressiveness. FPO++ refines flow-matching policy gradients to train and fine-tune expressive flow policies directly from rewards without exact action likelihoods, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across quadrupeds, two humanoid robots, and manipulation tasks. It offers a practical generative RL recipe, though multi-step sampling overhead and hyperparameter sensitivity remain trade-offs.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Oral；将流匹配生成式策略直接接入在线强化学习并跑通两台人形真机迁移，代表控制策略分布的重要演进。

prerequisites: 策略梯度与 PPO / Policy gradients and PPO

lv.whyRead: P0/P1 核心控制线：理解“为什么高斯 PPO 表达受限”以及生成式流策略如何直接做 RL 微调。
lv.relation: 连接模仿学习中的流匹配策略与强化学习中的真机迁移微调。
prerequisites: 强化学习基础 / Reinforcement learning basics
扩散或流生成模型直觉 / Diffusion or flow policy intuition

limits: 流策略推理需多步 ODE 积分，高频实时控制下需在采样步数与计算延迟间折中。 / Multi-step ODE sampling adds inference latency in high-frequency real-time control loops.
相比标准高斯 PPO，FPO++ 的流损失裁剪与噪声调度仍需针对任务稳定性仔细调参。 / Flow loss clipping and noise schedules still require careful tuning compared with standard Gaussian PPO.
assumptions: 环境仿真可提供大规模并行交互采样，且动力学随机化覆盖真机物理偏差。 / Assumes massively parallel simulation with domain randomization covering hardware dynamics.

papers.title: BiDexGrasp：跨物体几何与尺度的双臂灵巧手协同抓取
papers.titleEn: BiDexGrasp: Coordinated Bimanual Dexterous Grasps across Object Geometries and Sizes
papers.summary: 双臂多指灵巧抓取维度极高，长期缺乏跨尺度高质量数据与协同生成模型。BiDexGrasp提出区域约束初始化与解耦力闭合优化的两阶段合成管线，构建覆盖6351个不同几何与尺寸物体的数据集，并设计尺寸自适应协同抓取生成框架。它在跨尺度物体上显著提升物理稳定性，但目前以静态力闭合抓取为主，动态重抓与闭环触觉反馈尚未纳入。
papers.summaryEn: High-dimensional bimanual dexterous grasping lacks diverse multi-scale datasets and coordinated generators. BiDexGrasp introduces a two-stage synthesis pipeline combining region-constrained initialization and decoupled force-closure optimization to build a dataset over 6,351 objects of varied geometries and sizes, paired with a geometry-size-adaptive bimanual generator. It boosts physical grasp stability across scales, though dynamic regrasping and closed-loop tactile feedback remain unaddressed.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Spotlight；系统补齐双臂灵巧手跨尺度数据合成与协同抓取生成框架，适合关注灵巧操作与数据管线的读者。

prerequisites: 力闭合抓取基础 / Force-closure grasping

limits: 数据合成侧重刚性物体静态双臂力闭合抓取，未覆盖柔性形变物体或后续操作中的动态换手。 / Synthesis targets static rigid-object force-closure grasps and does not cover deformable objects or dynamic in-hand regrasp.
缺少真实触觉闭环误差恢复，对物体质量分布与摩擦系数的未知偏移较敏感。 / Lacks closed-loop tactile error recovery and remains sensitive to unmodeled mass or friction shifts.

papers.titleEn: MaskPlanner: A Framework for 3D Learning-Based Object-Centric Motion Generation and Applications to Robotic Spray Painting
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Robotics（T-RO 2026 · Vol. 42 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 工业喷涂、焊接等任务需要在自由曲面上生成多条无序长时程轨迹，传统启发式与优化方法泛化性差。MaskPlanner直接以3D点云为输入，联合预测局部路径段与掩码分组再拼接成完整可执行轨迹，并扩展PaintNet数据集。该工作把工业曲面路径规划抽象为3D集合预测问题，但在强遮挡点云和动态障碍避碰场景下仍需结合传统约束求解。
papers.summaryEn: Industrial spray painting and welding require planning multiple long-horizon trajectories over free-form 3D surfaces where heuristics generalize poorly. MaskPlanner takes 3D point clouds directly, jointly predicting local path segments and mask groupings that concatenate into executable trajectories, alongside an extended PaintNet dataset. It frames surface coverage planning as 3D set prediction, though heavy point-cloud occlusion and dynamic obstacle avoidance still require downstream constraint handling.
papers.whySelected: IEEE T-RO 2026 正式期刊论文；以学习式3D集合预测统一自由曲面轨迹规划，对工业操作泛化与数据集建设有扎实工程价值。

papers.title: DexRepNet++：基于几何与空间手物表征的灵巧操作学习
papers.titleEn: DexRepNet++: Learning Dexterous Robotic Manipulation With Geometric and Spatial Hand-Object Representations
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Robotics（T-RO 2026 · Vol. 42 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 多指灵巧手强化学习常聚焦动作空间采样效率，却忽视手与物体交互输入表征对跨物体泛化的决定作用。DexRepNet++设计融合占据、表面特征与局部几何关系的DexRep表征，在抓取、手内重定位与双臂协作三类任务上显著提升未见物体泛化能力。该表征思路清晰，但对精确物体三维几何先验的依赖在真实部分观测下仍是瓶颈。
papers.summaryEn: Multi-fingered dexterous RL often focuses on action-space efficiency while overlooking input representations of hand-object interaction. DexRepNet++ introduces DexRep, combining occupancy, surface, and local geometric features to substantially boost unseen-object generalization across grasping, in-hand reorientation, and bimanual tasks. While conceptually clean, its reliance on accurate 3D object geometry remains a bottleneck under noisy partial real-world observations.
papers.whySelected: IEEE T-RO 2026 正式期刊论文；系统验证手物局部几何表征在三类高自由度灵巧操作中的跨物体泛化收益。

papers.title: 半环注解数据库上的 Codd 定理
papers.titleEn: Codd's Theorem for Databases over Semirings
papers.venue: PODS 2026 / PACMMOD Vol. 3 No. 5（正式发表）
papers.summary: 经典 Codd 定理确立了关系代数与关系演算的等价性，但在溯源半环注解数据库上该等价性不再自动成立。作者面向带单调减（monus）的半环数据库，分别对五种基本关系代数运算及引入除法运算的情形建立了两版半环 Codd 定理，揭示除法在半环语义下不再可由基本运算表达。结果奠定了带否定溯源查询语言设计的理论边界，聚焦表达力而非工程求值。
papers.summaryEn: Classical Codd’s theorem equates relational algebra and calculus, yet this equivalence breaks over provenance semiring-annotated databases. Using semirings with monus, the authors establish two semiring versions of Codd’s theorem—one for the five basic algebra operators and one adding division—showing that division is no longer definable from basic operators over semirings. This sharpens the theoretical boundary of provenance query languages with negation, focusing on expressiveness rather than engine execution.
papers.whySelected: PODS/PACMMOD 核心理论成果；直接拓展 Green-Karvounarakis-Tannen 溯源半环框架下的代数/演算等价理论，与李的溯源与逻辑主线高度契合。

sources.label: 正式会议身份 / Formal venue

li.whyRead: 必读核心理论：厘清带 monus 减法的溯源半环下，关系代数与一阶演算何时等价、为何除法独立。
li.relation: 直接深化 provenance semirings 与带否定查询语义理论，支撑理解视图/溯源代数重写边界。
prerequisites: 关系代数与一阶逻辑 / Relational algebra and FOL

limits: 纯理论表达力刻画，未涉及半环注解查询在数据库引擎中的物理执行与索引优化。 / Purely an expressiveness characterization without physical execution or indexing strategies.
结果依赖于带 monus 与 support 算子的特定半环类及受限否定片段，不覆盖任意非交换或无 monus 半环。 / Applies to semirings with monus and support under restricted negation, not arbitrary non-commutative or monus-free semirings.
assumptions: 注解结构满足带单调减法（m-semiring）及支持度算子的代数公理。 / Assumes annotation structures satisfy m-semiring axioms with a support operator.
